name: Place de la Mairie
camera: south edge of the square, eye level, facing north

setting.walls: five facades: B14 white columned Palais de Justice (left), B63 red-brick fire station with hose tower (back left), B13 cream town hall with slate mansard, belfry and tricolour (back centre), B16 ochre barracks museum gate with striped sentry boxes (back right), B15 yellow-and-blue post office with round clock (right)
setting.floor: pale beige paving stones with two curved flower beds
setting.landmark: a white-and-sage-green wrought-iron bandstand (kiosque) in the centre
setting.style: S06 square: calm civic storybook painterly 3/5
